messages:
maria: FYI Acme POC is hitting intermittent 5xx during the load run. Repro when we ramp to ~800-1k RPS. Seeing gRPC errors + gateway 502s and some worker OOMs. Can we swarm?
infra-bot: Alert: high 5xx rate for project acme-poc (5xx_rate > 8%). Autoscale triggered; observed scale lag ~18s.
sam: Can you paste the logs/error samples? Is this hosted or dedicated?
maria: Hosted. Pinned model: redwood/rw-large-v1 - here's a snippet: 
```
2025-03-04T15:12:07Z ERROR inference worker: OOM, pid=2345, restarting
2025-03-04T15:12:08Z WARN gateway: upstream returned 502 for request /v1/generate
metrics: 5xx_rate=12%, tail_p95=4.8s, queue_len=320
```
jeff: Likely hit two issues: (1) autoscale cold-start / scale-out latency under burst; (2) continuous batching backlog causing long queue lengths and then OOMs when workers try to process large batches.
jeff: Immediate mitigations: lower batch size, enable burst capacity on the pool, or route heavy traffic to a smaller quantized variant while scaling finishes. Also check if multiple requests are getting pinned to one shard. @maria
lucy: For POC speed, try a quantized fallback: redwood/rw-large-q4 or rw-medium-q4 — they reduce memory and latency during spikes.
sam: Are KV cache misses significant? If the cache is cold the first wave can be heavier. Any recent model update or rollout?
maria: No rollout since yesterday; cache warmed during initial runs but spikes still create cache churn. Sessions seem sticky to a few workers.
jeff: Config changes I'd push: scale_window from 10s -> 5s, enable_burst=true, and a temporary lower max_batch_tokens. Also add a fallback route policy: on 5xx -> route to rw-large-q4. Example snippet: 
```json
{"routing": {"on_5xx": {"action": "fallback", "model": "redwood/rw-large-q4"}}}
```
sam: Good. Also collect these metrics for the sales ticket: per-worker memory, queue length over time, scale events, and gateway 502 traces. Can someone grab those dashboards?
ida-oncall: I'm applying the temp config now: scale_window=5s, enable_burst=true. Will also bump pool min_workers 4->8 for the next 20 minutes. ETA ~ 12 min to be fully in effect.
infra-bot: Rolling change started for pool acme-poc-gpu. Increasing min_workers 4 -> 8.
ina: Customer is in final eval, asking for ETA to stabilize. Please keep me posted. They care about tail 99 latency and no failures during their 10-minute stress run.
maria: After the change errors dropped a lot — 5xx_rate down to ~2%, tail_p95 -> 2.1s. Still seeing occasional 502s at very high concurrency spikes.
jeff: For those tail 502s, add the routing fallback and widen concurrency headroom: add burst tokens and lower per-request token limit (max_output_tokens). Also consider temporary rate-limit shaping on the client side to smooth the ramp.
sam: I'll open a short-run canary where we failover to rw-large-q4 after 3 consecutive 5xx. I'll also attach the metrics to the sales ticket and summarize causes and mitigations.
maria: Thanks team — running another 10-min stress now. Will post updated metrics. If this stabilizes we can tell Acme to re-run their acceptance test. :thumbsup:
